An Object holds a real as an f64, so 1.00000005960464478, just past halfway between two 32-bit floats, reaches the f64 of that half, which rounds to even, 1; PDFium parses the bytes straight to a 32-bit float, the one above 1. Resolve gives no number's bytes.
